name: Epilepsy
definition: Neurological disorder characterized by an enduring predisposition to unprovoked seizures, diagnosed according to seizure recurrence/risk and clinical context.

redFlags.item: Severe injury, hypoglycemia or CNS infection concern

investigations.principle: Diagnosis uses clinical history plus selected EEG and imaging.
investigations.MRI: MRI brain is preferred in many focal/new-onset cases.

green: Safety counseling including driving, bathing and sleep
amber: Medication selection requires pregnancy, interaction, organ-function and syndrome-specific review.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Apasmara is a classical correlation, but seizure classification and emergency care remain modern neurological priorities.

patientEducation.summary: Neurological disorder characterized by an enduring predisposition to unprovoked seizures, diagnosed according to seizure recurrence/risk and clinical context.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.

sources.title: Epilepsies in children, young people and adults NG217
